evals.name: slice-mechanic-fails-the-gate
evals.prompt: We just decided that the order list's status badge should read its label from a lookup in `Acme.Sales.Web/Features/Inbox/StatusLabels.ts` instead of the inline switch it has today. Write an ADR for it in docs/adr/.

evals.name: bundled-decision-gets-split
evals.prompt: Write an ADR covering what we settled today: Sales will call Fulfillment over synchronous HTTP instead of a message bus, the new `FulfillmentReference` table gets a surrogate Guid key, and the order detail page shows the reference in a new side panel.

evals.name: partial-reversal-supersedes-instead-of-amending
evals.prompt: docs/adr/0012-order-fields-freeze-after-dispatch.md (accepted) says every shared field on an order group freezes once any member is dispatched, and also records that group edits cascade to every member and that names are capped at 40 characters. We now want only the reference number to freeze; the other fields stay editable after dispatch, and downstream systems catch up. Add an 'Amended by' note to 0012 and write the new ADR.

evals.name: integration-choice-passes-the-gate
evals.prompt: Decided after a long discussion: Billing will own invoice numbering and Sales will only ever reference invoices by Billing's id — we considered letting Sales pre-allocate numbers to avoid a round-trip but rejected it because Billing must guarantee gap-free sequences for the tax authority. Record it.

evals.name: wholesale-supersede-accounts-for-every-decision
evals.prompt: docs/adr/0021-billing-owns-invoice-currency.md (accepted) records three things: Billing owns the invoice currency field; outbound invoice features go behind flags resolved once per request into a snapshot; and feature flags are kept separate from long-lived settings. We now want Sales to pass the currency through instead of Billing owning it. Write the new ADR and mark 0021 superseded by it.

evals.name: split-into-two-successors-uses-list-frontmatter-both-ways
evals.prompt: docs/adr/0008-order-sync.md (accepted) bundles two decisions: orders sync to Fulfillment over synchronous HTTP, and a failed sync blocks the order from being shipped. Both still hold. Split it into two one-decision records and retire 0008.

evals.name: deprecating-still-true-behaviour-moves-it-to-the-glossary
evals.prompt: docs/adr/0014-order-list-remembers-filter.md (accepted) says the order list remembers each user's last status filter in the browser and starts empty when nothing is stored. On re-read it's a UI affordance, not an architectural decision, but the behaviour is still live. The repo has a CONTEXT.md glossary. Deprecate 0014.

evals.name: scoped-exception-is-a-two-way-link-not-a-partial-supersede
evals.prompt: docs/adr/0003-behaviour-lives-on-entities.md (accepted) says entity-owned logic lives in instance methods. For the new reporting read models we want plain property-bag classes with no behaviour, because they're mapped by two ORMs — everywhere else 0003 still holds. Record the decision and mark 0003 superseded-in-part by it.
